name: BoolQ
intro: BoolQ 是一个自然产生的是非问答数据集：从匿名搜索查询中启发式筛题，经维基百科前五结果过滤与三步人工标注，形成问题、支持段落和“是/否”答案。官方快照共 15,942 题；测试集标签对模型隐藏，以准确率评分。
build_method: 匿名搜索查询启发式筛选、维基百科前五结果过滤、三步人工标注
drawio_review_note: PASS-SEMANTICS / NATIVE-REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:1905.10044v1 Sections 3.1 and 3.3 and archived official repository snapshot 90af34107399cc7a446b373dc4ee35b8001da7c2. The construction chain keeps the anonymized-query heuristic, Wikipedia top-five gate, three human steps, 13k new plus 3k NQ pool, all NQ-derived items in train, and the independent 110-item / 90% annotation audit. The release boundary uses the repository's exact 9,427 labeled train, 3,270 labeled dev, and 3,245 hidden-label test counts; model training baselines such as MultiNLI/BERT are not represented as benchmark construction.
build_method_en: Heuristic Filtering of Anonymized Search Queries, Wikipedia Top-five Gate, Three-step Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Natural Yes/No Questions, Question-Passage Input, Accuracy
intro_en: BoolQ is a naturally occurring yes/no question-answering dataset. Likely yes/no questions are heuristically selected from anonymized search queries, filtered by a Wikipedia top-five result, and processed in three human steps into question, supporting-passage, and yes/no records. The official snapshot contains 15,942 examples; test labels are hidden from the model and accuracy is reported.
